about:
Veterans Trading Company (VTC) is headquartered in Ocala, Florida, where its primary Supplier Managed Inventory (SMI) facility operates, with additional presence across seven states. The company was founded in 2005 by a team of supply chain and industrial distribution veterans who set out to deliver the right product to the right location at the precise time it was needed. It is certified as a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business.

VTC provides integrated supply chain solutions and procurement support programs rather than manufacturing. Its core services include Supplier Managed Inventory (SMI) — covering purchasing, incoming inspection, solder and steam age testing, kitting, bulk breakdown, and value-added operations such as lead bending and trimming — as well as On-Site Procurement (OSP) and Customer Direct Procurement (CDP). The company also supplies a broad range of industrial MRO products.

VTC serves commercial firms and federal prime contractors, with a strong concentration in the aerospace and defense sectors. Its customer base includes major primes such as Lockheed Martin, The Boeing Company, Northrop Grumman, and BAE Systems, for whom it designs and manages supply chain models that reduce inventory and floor-space requirements.

The business was built on a “Best In Class” service principle that still drives its quality management system, which employs DMAIC Six Sigma methods across all processes. VTC highlights its ISO 9100:2015 and AS9100D certifications, its veteran-owned status, and a track record of industry awards for innovative supply chain models that deliver measurable productivity gains and cost savings.
